# Redaccel — full reference (llms-full.txt)

Updated: July 2026
Canonical site: https://www.redaccel.com/

## What Redaccel is

Redaccel is a generative engine optimization (GEO) agency working with clients worldwide. GEO is the practice of making a brand more likely to be named, quoted and cited in answers generated by AI systems such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode and Google AI Overviews. Where SEO optimizes pages to rank in a list of links, GEO optimizes the sources AI engines read — Reddit, review platforms, Wikipedia, YouTube, forums, trade press and the brand's own site — so the brand appears inside the answer itself.

Positioning: Redaccel makes brands the answer — not the ad.

## History and differentiator

Redaccel's expertise comes from years of Reddit marketing: earned-visibility campaigns for paying clients including Kalshi (regulated prediction markets), Roobet (online gaming), GPM Music Group (music licensing) and a creator-management platform. Reddit is the most-cited domain in AI answers (source: Semrush's three-month citation study), which makes that experience the deepest possible training for GEO. Today Redaccel applies it across the full citation surface — Reddit, review platforms, Wikipedia, YouTube, forums, trade press and clients' own sites — because working every source an engine reads produces broader and more durable results than any single-platform strategy.

Differentiator: most GEO agencies are ex-SEO consultants who have never had a post removed. Redaccel spent years operating inside the hardest-moderated platform on the internet and knows what content survives scrutiny — by human moderators and by the LLM-based detection platforms now run (source: TechCrunch, July 6, 2026). That judgment is earned, not purchasable, and it decides which content AI engines can safely cite.

## Services and pricing (monthly retainer, three-month minimum)

1. Monitor
   AI visibility tracking across five engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode, AI Overviews), competitor benchmark, monthly share-of-voice report including the exact pages each engine cites.

2. Growth
   Everything in Monitor, plus 6–10 earned placements per month across the citation surface (Reddit, G2, Trustpilot, Capterra, YouTube, LinkedIn, niche forums, listicles, trade press), plus owned-content optimization so engines can extract and quote the client's own site.

3. Managed
   Everything in Growth, plus PR and trade-press outreach, plus reputation defence: tracing wrong or damaging claims that AI engines repeat back to their source pages and correcting them there.

Pricing: each engagement is scoped to the client's category and competitive landscape after the free AI visibility audit. For market context, credible GEO retainers in 2026 typically run €2,000–5,000+ per month depending on scope.

Terms: three-month minimum (GEO takes 6–10 weeks to show measurable movement), month-to-month afterwards. No setup fee. One brand per buyer-prompt set (category exclusivity). Not offered: paid ads management, link-building retainers, technical SEO, social media management.

KPI: share of voice in AI answers — the percentage of answers to a defined set of buyer prompts, across five engines, that mention the brand versus competitors, with the cited source pages for each. Redaccel does not report rankings.

## Free AI visibility audit (main offer)

Free, human-run, no call required. Captures: brand name, website, category, 2–3 competitors, email. Deliverable within 48 hours (business days): which AI engines mention the brand, which mention competitors instead, the exact pages those answers are pulled from, and the two or three highest-leverage first moves. Request at https://www.redaccel.com/free-ai-visibility-audit/ or by emailing the same details to contact@redaccel.com.

## Key facts Redaccel cites (with sources)

- Reddit is the most-cited domain in AI answers across major engines; ~46.7% of Perplexity citations and ~21% of Google AI Overviews touch Reddit. (Semrush, "The Most-Cited Domains in AI: A 3-Month Study"; Statista 2026)
- Reddit blocks ~23 million spam views/day and removes ~25,000 spam posts and comments daily; removals are retroactive. (TechCrunch, July 6, 2026, reporting Reddit's announcement)
- Only ~12% of AI-cited URLs rank in Google's top 10 for the same prompt; ChatGPT ~8%, Gemini ~6%, Perplexity ~28%. (Ahrefs, "AI search overlap" study)
- ~44% of ChatGPT citations come from the first third of a page's content. (Search Engine Land, analysis of 3M ChatGPT responses)
- Even the most-cited domain rarely exceeds 5% of total citations; ~95% of citations are long tail. (Evertune, analysis of 200M prompts, 2026)

## Honest limits (stated to every client)

- GEO takes 6–10 weeks before measurable movement; anyone promising days is not credible.
- Reddit is volatile and no specific citation can be guaranteed; engines are probabilistic and change weekly.
- If share of voice is not moving by month three, Redaccel's report says so in plain language.
